notes: TWO folded thicknesses are published, split by colour variant (not hinge/non-hinge side): Black Version folded 9.2 mm / unfolded 4.35 mm @ approx. 226 g, Other Version folded 9.3 mm / unfolded 4.4 mm @ approx. 230 g. Per the larger-value rule the Other Version figures are recorded (9.3 / 4.4 / 230 g); 9.2 mm / 226 g is the figure HONOR markets. No hinge-side value is published so depth_at_hinge is null. Height 156.6 mm is published as one value for both states. hinge.crease is null: neither the global page nor the China page (https://www.honor.com/cn/phones/honor-magic-v3/) contains any water-drop/teardrop or U-crease claim - they say only "Low visible crease" and "HONOR Super Steel Hinge ... one-piece arch bridge structure". Cover-screen refresh_hz is null: the global page states the outer screen has "All-range Low Power LTPO" and a "1Hz minimum refresh rate" but never states its maximum; the China page likewise says only "全域低功耗 LTPO显示技术，刷新率低至1Hz" ("all-range low-power LTPO display technology, refresh rate as low as 1 Hz"). Only the inner screen's 1-120 Hz is stated, so only that display carries 120. Display aspect ratios are not published for this model (unlike the Magic V2 page) - left null. materials.frame null: the China page names "自研高强7系铝合金" ("self-developed high-strength 7-series aluminium alloy") as a body material but never ties it to the frame/middle frame, so it is not recorded as materials.frame. materials.back: the China page footnote restricts the fibre to one colour - "航天特种纤维仅荣耀Magic V3绒黑色支持" ("the aerospace special fibre is supported only on the HONOR Magic V3 Velvet Black"). resolution_px recorded in HONOR's printed order (long axis first). active_area_mm left null - HONOR states the diagonals are standard-rectangle measurements and the actual viewable area is slightly smaller. || EVIDENCE SWEEP 2026-09-13: these values were present in the research pass but carried NO sources[] entry covering their field, so they were set to null per the registry rule (a value without a citation is an assertion, not evidence).
